title: No One Left

criterion_results.form_integrity: A — the semantic change is not merely described; it is stored only in the paired WAL and independently replayable.
criterion_results.specificity_density: A — every field is load-bearing and the zero-departure fact prevents the category change from collapsing into ordinary vacancy.
criterion_results.closure_risk: A — CURRENT STATUS | VACANT does not console or explain; it leaves a live contradiction with PERSONS LIVING IN UNIT | YES.
criterion_results.diction_risk: B/A boundary — administrative diction is severe and exact, though the title may over-prime the double meaning.
criterion_results.disclosure_survival: A — disclosure deepens the page because the base is genuinely OCCUPIED and one WAL update produces VACANT without a departure.
criterion_results.need_test: A — removing the database/WAL split would remove the poem’s central event rather than merely its proof apparatus.

pairwise_order_swap.reason: D004 removes the unrelated inspection branch and realizes the previously missing occupied-to-vacant transition while nobody leaves.
D001’s absence inventory is replaceable; D004’s exact one-field reclassification is formally and semantically irreducible.

strengths: The page can be read before the apparatus: persons are present, departures are zero, and the status nevertheless becomes vacant.
The title “No One Left” works in two directions without requiring a narrative explanation: nobody departed, and administrative language says nobody remains in the relevant sense.
The artifact is not a receipt pasted behind a conventional poem; the main database alone and the paired database/WAL state are genuinely different readings.
The eight-line concentration eliminates the familiar domestic traces and source paraphrase that weakened D001–D003.
residual_risks: The title may solve the double meaning too quickly and make the work feel like a database riddle.
A reader unfamiliar with survey classification may experience the usual-residence field as imported authority rather than felt pressure.
The static reader edition presents verified states but does not itself execute SQLite; the canonical artifact remains the database/WAL pair.
No external disclosed reader has tested whether the surface remains interesting after full mechanism disclosure.
candidate_action: Freeze D004 as the second internal anthology candidate. Do not create D005 merely to continue the lineage. Preserve exact draft, packet, database, WAL, spec, receipt, and surfaces.

lineage.successor_trigger: A concrete later external-reader failure or project-owner line-level instruction, not internal motion for its own sake.
